notes: Opt-in standard KWP2000 (ISO 14230) read-only diagnostics only, where the selected ECU answers fast or 5-baud init and speaks addressed ISO 14230 framing at 10400 baud. Not established for any particular motorcycle. Synthetic integration tests only. Read-only services only: readECUIdentification (0x1A), readDataByLocalIdentifier (0x21), readDTCByStatus (0x18), testerPresent; every mutating service is refused by the session guard before transmission. Requires a correct K-Line adapter.

session.physical_evidence_note: Standard ISO 14230 read-only services only; no model-specific fitment is claimed. This integration is synthetic-tested only.

identification.note: KWP2000 readECUIdentification option 0x80, returned raw. Not confirmed ECU hardware identity or any programming authorization.

memory.write_blocked_reason: The generic KWP2000 profile exposes no memory read and no write path; readMemoryByAddress (0x23) is not in the read-only allowlist.

sources: ISO 14230-2 / ISO 14230-3 (KWP2000 data link and application layer)
Fiat 'Standard Diagnostic Protocol on K-Line KWP 2000' (06/07/2000, archived) - service list and 5-baud key-byte handshake
